searchLog: Infrastructure failure, not an honest zero: this session's WebFetch tool could not resolve any external domain except anthropic.com (confirmed failures: boards-api.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, www.databricks.com, scale.com, openai.com, jobs.thrivecap.com, www.google.com, en.wikipedia.org — all getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, meaning the session's network allowlist, not the sites themselves, blocked them). WebSearch worked and surfaced plausible leads (Databricks Associate Product Manager New Grad 2027 Start; Scale AI Strategic Projects Lead - New Grad; Anthropic Applied AI Architect family; Ramp Forward Deployed roles), but hunt.md's verification rule requires confirming eligibility, open status, and deadline from the actual live page, not a search snippet or aggregator mirror — and that step was impossible for every target company except Anthropic's own site. On anthropic.com directly (the one domain that worked): fetched the live careers board (70 Applied AI roles, 24 TPM roles) and confirmed via search that every Applied AI Architect posting requires 3+ years of customer-facing/technical experience (up to 8-10+ for senior variants) and there is no new-grad TPM pipeline, per target-companies.json's own note — so nothing there clears the no-3+-YOE bar either. Result: zero items pass verification today, but the cause is that verification tooling was unavailable, not that the market was empty.
